recap.title: Choose Joy
items: Joy is the oldest medicine — and it's a choice
Joy is not a reward for an easy life

scenes.point: Joy is a choice you make before the answer comes
Decide in advance: whatever comes, I will not be moved
Rejoice before the outcome — that's real faith
